title: oncall handoff checksum and telemetry synthesizer for compact context transfer
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: handoffs during high-pressure incidents frequently lost critical context (partial traces, clipped logs, ad-hoc snippets). This PR adds two complementary features to reduce costly context gaps: 1) a deterministic handoff checksum attached to every incident-bot handoff message that verifies payload fidelity across tools; 2) a telemetry synthesizer service that constructs a compact, privacy-safe summary of missing spans/events when downstream telemetry is sparse. The checksum is a canonical JSON serialization + SHA256 digest with stable ordering and configurable salt, surfaced as 'handoff_checksum' in handoff payloads and displayed in the oncall UI; operators can use it to assert the handoff message received by downstream runbooks/Slack threads matches the sent content. The telemetry synthesizer runs as an opt-in stage during handoff: it inspects available traces/logs, infers any missing 'critical markers' (eg. deploy markers, leader-loss events, DB failovers) using lightweight heuristics, and emits a synthetic summary under a retention TTL and privacy filters (PII redaction). Implementation notes: added new CLI flags --handoff-checksum and --synth-telemetry-ttl; backend uses an in-memory LRU cache to dedupe synth outputs; synth output includes provenance metadata and confidence scores for each synthesized item. Checklist: - implement checksum generation and attach to handoff payloads - add synth heuristics and TTL-based retention - UI: show checksum and synth summary link in handoff modal - tests: unit tests for canonicalization, synth heuristics, and e2e handoff flow - docs: upgrade oncall runbook template with checksum verification steps High level commits: 1) add checksum generator and unit tests 2) add telemetry synthesizer module + heuristics 3) wire CLI flags and config parsing 4) UI changes to surface checksum and synth links 5) tests, docs, and changelog. Changed areas: backend/handshake/handshake.go (checksum logic), backend/synth/synthesizer.py (heuristics engine), cli/handoff_cli.go (flags), webapp/src/components/HandoffModal.tsx (UI), docs/oncall/handoff-checksum.md, tests/{unit,e2e}_handoff_test.*. Review conversation summary: Liam O'Connor: 'Strong utility, but ensure TTL and privacy filters are explicit and configurable.' Maya: 'Added TTL flag and explicit redaction step; default TTL set to 7 days and can be shortened per-org.' Priya Natarajan: 'Can we gate synth by incident severity? Least-privilege for low-priority incidents.' Maya: 'Added severity gating (configurable threshold) and included examples in docs.' Diego Alvarez: 'Please add load tests for the synth path.' Maya: 'Added simple load smoke test and circuit-breaker to prevent synth storms.' CI summary: initial run failed lint on webapp; fixed formatting and re-ran CI; final run passed all checks (unit, lint, e2e smoke). Merge outcome: merged via squash-merge, changelog entry added to release notes. Release notes: 'improve oncall handoffs: include deterministic checksum for handoff payloads and optional synthesized telemetry summaries to fill sparse traces; configurable TTL and severity gating; docs updated with verification steps and examples.'
release_notes: Added deterministic handoff checksum and optional synthesized telemetry summaries for incident handoffs. Configurable TTL, severity gating, and privacy redaction. See docs/oncall/handoff-checksum.md for verification steps.
